# Styled Blocks and Source Annotations

<strong>Quote Paragraph</strong>

> Quoted **paragraph** text.
> — Ada Lovelace, <cite>Notes</cite>

<strong>Verse Paragraph</strong>

> First verse line\
> Second verse line
> — Emily Dickinson, <cite>Poem</cite>

<strong>Literal Paragraph</strong>

```
literal <text>
  indented literal line
```

<strong>Listing Paragraph</strong>

```
listing <text>
  indented listing line
```

<strong>Source Paragraph</strong>

```rust
fn paragraph() {
    println!("source");
}
```

<strong>Example 1. Example Paragraph</strong>

<!-- Warning: example paragraphs not natively supported in Markdown, using blockquote -->
> Example **paragraph** text.

<strong>Abstract Paragraph</strong>

> Abstract **paragraph** text.

<div class="raw">raw & exact</div>

```rust
fn repeat() {}
```

```php
<p><?php echo "hello"; ?></p>
```

```php
<p><?php echo "again"; ?></p>
```
